name: opencad
description: Generate validated STEP and STL models from natural-language requirements.

interface.shortDescription: Generate validated STEP and STL from text.
interface.longDescription: OpenCAD turns dimensional part descriptions into editable Python models and validated STEP or STL artifacts.
defaultPrompt: Create a dimensioned CAD part and export STEP and STL.
Turn this mechanical sketch into an editable STEP model.
Revise my OpenCAD model and validate the result.
